title: ajania glomerata
intro: Ajania glomerata, commonly known as Khasya or Himalayan Chrysanthemum, is a perennial plant species native to the mountainous regions of the Himalayas. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to alleviate various health issues, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which provide health benefits such as reducing fever, treating cold and flu, and soothing digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Ajania glomerata include its analgesic, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, which help in relieving pain, reducing fever, and facilitating the expulsion of mucus from the respiratory tract. The bioactive constituents of Ajania glomerata include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
